review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner, design self-review; not independent approval
review.decision: Close independent F1/F2 with exact provider schemas rather than generic parameter guessing
review.notes: Independent Q report and manifest fully read and SHA checked. F1: OpenCode v1/DSH skill name and OpenCode v2 skill id; F2: DSH web_search queries array. R476 is only a normal merge of reviewed association main and still inherits both gaps. Preserve ASA001..005 and native mirror/ref/redaction controls. Add explicit provider context only at the two known adapters; generic or MCP name/id cannot become a skill identity. Validate conflicts/types and bound arrays/summary without executing or querying tools. First demonstrate exact R production target failures, then new green and final actual-adapter output through existing generated presenters. No live user input, provider process, network search, session restore or App/service changes.

cases.description: Native provider skill identities remain factual
cases.setup: Real DSH skill arguments/name string, OpenCode V1 name and V2 id through portable adapter, Claude legacy skill; invalid/conflicting fields and foreign/MCP names.
cases.action: Parse actual provider events and inspect the single recorded step and unchanged raw input/ref.
cases.expected: Only exact known provider/tool schemas permit name/id; valid forms show skill action and bounded identity once. Missing/wrong/conflicting/foreign parameters remain neutral; existing canonical path reads, legacy skill and native mirror controls stay unchanged.

cases.description: DSH multiple search queries retain a bounded target preview
cases.setup: Real dsh tool/call web_search with queries string array and mixed/empty/oversized array controls, ordinary query/web_fetch controls.
cases.action: Parse actual append events and inspect operation/action/detail/count/input.
cases.expected: A valid 1..64 typed nonblank query array supplies a clipped preview from at most three entries, preserving one call and the original input/ref. Invalid arrays do not create a guessed preview; only exact DSH web_search gains this schema.

cases.description: Native skill and query facts reach Chat and Trace
cases.setup: Recorded step shapes from the provider cases and old/malformed neutral controls.
cases.action: Run shared bilingual Chat/Trace presentation and separately pass actual Go adapter output to generated browser/Trace.
cases.expected: Skill name and search text match recorded facts across surfaces; one invocation remains one row/call, original objects/refs remain unchanged and unsupported records retain the existing fallback.
